$comment: Decided 2026-11-17: follow the native study (docs/native-ui-study.md section 7.2) wherever it differs from the mockup. The one source of Calternal's design tokens (docs/ui-shell.md, docs/ui-design-system.md). scripts/build-tokens.mjs emits src/styles/tokens.generated.css from it; native clients read this file directly. Values ported from the mockup (origin/review/switcher-a-pills packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css). Names have no leading dashes.

light.glass-edge: inset 0 0 20px rgb(var(--tint) / 0.3), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6)

dark.glass-edge: inset 0 0 20px rgb(var(--tint) / 0.3), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12)

touch.$comment: Motion by form (native study): touch panels and sheets run 340 ms on a curve fitted to the measured push (50 % by 0.10 s, 90 % by 0.23 s, 98 % by 0.32 s); a desktop sheet or sidebar runs 190 ms on the Mac curve (0.1, 0.3, 0.8, 1). Icons: two tiers per form, each at one size and one stroke chosen so the rendered line is about 1.4 px at every size (stroke units are in the 24 grid): glyph for controls, glyph-inline beside text. Phones and tablets: bigger hit targets (the control tier pill-h is the 44 px minimum), larger glyphs, lighter blur (cheaper on a phone GPU).

touchText.$comment: The phone's type scale is read from the measured iOS Dynamic Type table (docs/native-ui-study.json, ios.dynamicType) at its default Large size, not typed by hand. token -> text style. scripts/build-tokens.mjs emits the sizes; line height is 1.193 x the size in the table and the web uses its own for reading.

desktop.$comment: A desktop with a fine pointer and hover: compact rows, 18 px glyphs, full blur.

backdrop.$comment: A 3 by 3 mesh of colours, left to right, top to bottom. Only its mean paints the no-wallpaper ground (flat, no gradient); the mesh itself is the brightness data surfaces use until a wallpaper is ready (lib/material.ts).

appearance.$comment: Choices the owner has not settled yet, kept as data (docs/ui-backgrounds-and-themes.md Open): which look is the default, the grain strength (0 turns it off) and which preset is first.

springs.$comment: One spring (damping ratio, response in seconds), emitted as --spring, a CSS linear() easing, to run over --dur-slow. Three durations (fast 120, base 220, slow 300) and two curves (ease-out, spring) are the whole motion set.
